title: Dyna-Living Water Fountains Indoor Tabletop Water Fountain & Waterfalls | With Colorful LED Crystal Ball, Soothing Water Flow Sound, Quiet Pump for Relaxation, Office, Living Room or Bedroom Décor

videos.creator: Seller
videos.description: • A how-to video on product assembly that walks through setting up the Dyna-Living Rockery Waterfall Tabletop Fountain, covering all included parts and each assembly step in order. • Package contents include the rockery upper section, a black basin bowl, a water pump with power cord, a ring LED light, and a crystal ball. • Assembly steps shown: thread the water pipe through the center of the ring LED light, connect the pipe to the water pump, adjust the pump's flow speed setting, place the rockery upper section into the basin, position the crystal ball on top, then plug the pump into an electrical outlet to start the fountain.
